messages:
Maria (partnerships): Quick sync — we need to lock the package/seat model and trial flow for AWS/GCP/Azure listings. Who can map seat tiers -> marketplace SKUs + trial entitlements?
Dan (product): I can take the product mapping. Question: do we want 3 SKUs (starter/pro/enterprise) or a single bundle with optional add-ons?
Maria (partnerships): Prefer explicit SKUs per tier for cloud storefront discoverability. Add-ons as separate SKUs if needed. Need trial gating too (14d trial) and auto-convert behavior documented.
Raj (eng): From infra side, marketplace metering differs. AWS uses SaaS subscriptions or Metering API; GCP wants billing SKU + trials via promo codes; Azure expects offers with metering/usage API. We should avoid a single-meter design.
Priya (marketplace-ops): +1. I'll draft per-cloud entitlement flows. For trials: AWS can auto-provision 14d trial entitlement, GCP we need a trial coupon flow, Azure trial has TOS acceptance step.
Leo (finance): Also need to confirm revenue recognition: AWS metered transactions report delays. For seat model, include per-seat price and monthly/annual options. Send me a price matrix.
Sarah (legal): Legal checklist: provide EULA, SOC2 statement, data processing addendum, contact for security review. Also need distribution agreement specifics per marketplace. I can draft annexes per cloud.
Maria (partnerships): Action items: Dan -> pricing matrix + SKU names; Raj -> metering integration notes + any missing telemetry hooks; Priya -> per-cloud trial gating playbook; Sarah -> marketplace annex drafts; Leo -> pricing review. Can we get first draft by EOD Thu?
Dan (product): Working on matrix. Quick thought: name SKUs as "Redwood Core Starter", "Redwood Core Scale", "Redwood Core Enterprise". Short descriptions for storefront copy too.
Raj (eng): For metering, sample snippet to report seat usage (pseudo):
```
POST /metering/report
{ "offerId": "offer-123", "skuId": "sku-starter", "quantity": 5, "timestamp": 1650000000 }
```
We'll also need a webhook to accept marketplace provisioning events.
Priya (marketplace-ops): Good. Also need assets: hero image 1200x627, 2 screenshots, short blurb (120 chars) + long blurb (500 chars). I'll prepare an assets checklist.
Maria (partnerships): Legal question: are we ok with trial auto-convert to paid if user enters CC? Sarah?
Sarah (legal): We need explicit consent language. Marketplace policies vary: Azure forbids hidden charges. We'll add explicit opt-in text and mention trial expiration reminder.
Leo (finance): For taxes: allocate field for VAT/ GST. Cloud marketplaces handle some tax flows differently; capture tax classification per customer region.
Dan (product): UI/UX note: add a small banner in-app when marketplace trial is active so users know it's via AWS/GCP/Azure.
Raj (eng): Dev tasks: webhook endpoint, metering client, entitlement reconciliation job. ETA: 2 sprints for initial MVP. Need listing sandbox creds from cloud teams.
Priya (marketplace-ops): Can request staging publisher accounts. Also we need to test refunds/chargeback flows in sandbox.
Maria (partnerships): Timeline proposal: Drafts by Thu, internal review Fri, package upload to AWS/GCP/Azure staging next Tue, smoke tests Wed, go/no-go Fri. Sound reasonable?
Dan (product): Sounds good. I'll attach pricing matrix by Thu morning.
Sarah (legal): I'll circulate annex drafts and consent text by Thu afternoon.
Leo (finance): I'll validate the tax/timing notes after seeing the matrix.
listing-bot: created task #PL-4321: "Marketplace package + trial flow — draft" assigned to Dan, Raj, Priya, Sarah, Leo — due 2025-04-10.
Maria (partnerships): Thanks everyone — ping me in-thread if blockers pop up. :thumbsup:
